title: Normalized comparison square for open projection
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, j : U → X an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and F in D(U_et,Λ), B in D(X_et,Λ) [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories,def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let C_U and C_X be the exact termwise comparison pullbacks [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let e be the derived adjoint-normalized extension comparison obtained termwise from [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], let r be the canonical comparison C_U Lj_et* ≅ Lj_proet* C_X obtained by conjugating the exact derived inverse-image square by the exact-to-left-derived isomorphisms, and let T be the canonical derived tensor comparison [def-kun-derived-tensor]. If κ_et and κ_proet denote the canonical open projection adjuncts, then C_X(κ_et(F,B)) followed by T_X and tensor(e_F,1) equals e_(F tensor Lj_et* B) followed by j!_proet(T_U followed by tensor(1,r_B)) and κ_proet(C_U F,C_X B). The exact canonical composites are fixed in lean.statement; the assertion is an equality for arbitrary unbounded objects with no local-freeness or boundedness hypothesis.

proof.text: The ordinary unit normalization, converted from restriction to inverse image, identifies the inverse extension comparison as a mate. Derive that equality by mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_mate. Compatibility of left-derived tensor comparisons with the inverse-image square is preserved when restriction is replaced by exact termwise restriction, giving compatibility of the mixed comparisons defining the projection maps. Apply Adjunction.projectionMap_mate. Cancel the inverse extension comparison and its tensor, and reassociate to obtain the displayed canonical square. No boundedness is involved.

theorem openProjectionTransport_projection_square
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (F : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (B : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (((Etale.derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionMap
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).app F).app B) ≫
      ((derivedTensorObjCompMapDerivedCategoryComparisonUpperStarIso
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj F)).app B ≪≫
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).mapIso
      ((((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
      (openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j) ≪≫
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _)).app F)).app _).hom =
    ((((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
      (openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j) ≪≫
    Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _)).app _ ≪≫
    (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
      (((derivedTensorObjCompMapDerivedCategoryComparisonUpperStarIso
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) F).app _) ≪≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U).obj _).mapIso
          (((Functor.isoWhiskerRight
      (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j) _ ≪≫
    ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j) ≪≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _
      (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).symm)).app B))).hom ≫
      ((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).app
        ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj F)).app
        ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj B)
